list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: 4-Methylpyridinium salt containing binuclear and tetranuclear aqua/chloro lanthanum(III) anions

material_class.structural_family: discrete mixed binuclear and tetranuclear aqua/chloro lanthanum(III) anions

source_locations.location: Discussion, paragraphs describing the binuclear and tetranuclear complex anions; Fig. 1
Structure determinations section; deposition range CCDC 614336–614348; matched to supplied catalog metadata

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete La6 assembly contains a centrosymmetric binuclear aqua/chloro lanthanum anion and a centrosymmetric tetranuclear anion derived from it; the article notes disorder in the binuclear component.

synthesis.procedure: The authors report that the materials were initially obtained adventitiously by prolonged standing of anhydrous lanthanoid chloride under 4-methylpyridine. They then describe obtaining the extended series by crystallizing an aqueous lanthanoid chloride solution with (mpyH)Cl at a 1:3 stoichiometric ratio; this preparation description is general to the series rather than a separately detailed La6 procedure.

reagents.amount: 1:3 stoichiometric ratio of lanthanoid chloride to (mpyH)Cl
reagents.name: 4-methylpyridinium chloride

synthesis.vessel_or_method: prolonged standing; subsequent crystallization from aqueous solution
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallization of an aqueous lanthanoid chloride solution with (mpyH)Cl; the stated objective was crystalline material suitable for diffraction rather than bulk sample.

title: Structural Systematics of Rare Earth Complexes. XXII: 4-Methylpyridinium Salts of Diverse Complex Aqua/Chloro/Lanthanoid(III) Species
